name: Conceptual Captions 3M
description: A dataset of approximately 3.3 million image-caption pairs harvested from web pages and automatically filtered for image-caption relevance. This record describes the dataset only and does not distribute or vendor its data.
citation: Sharma, P., Ding, N., Goodman, S., & Soricut, R. (2018). Conceptual Captions: A Cleaned, Hypernymed, Image Alt-text Dataset For Automatic Image Captioning. Proceedings of the 56th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (Volume 1: Long Papers), 2556–2565. https://doi.org/10.18653/v1/P18-1238
